title: The Ken 11 forward test
description: A pre-registered, daily-updated forward test of the Ken 11: a personal index of the 11 largest US companies by full market value (excluding Alphabet, Tesla and Meta), weighted by size and rebalanced quarterly, with its cash reset every two weeks to hold a chosen volatility. Compared with SPY and with SPY plus cash at the same risk. Version 1.0 freezes the rules and predictions before the first day; each monthly version adds results only. Hypothetical performance; not investment advice.
